The default is \u003cem\u003eTrade Server\u003c/em\u003e, which runs as a console app. Click on the \u003cstrong\u003eRun Strategy\u003c/strong\u003e button. <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h6 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">.NET 10, WPF, ASP.NET Core WebHost, WebSockets, Prism, Unity</h6><a id="user-content-net-10-wpf-aspnet-core-webhost-websockets-prism-unity" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: .NET 10, WPF, ASP.NET Core WebHost, WebSockets, Prism, Unity" href="#net-10-wpf-aspnet-core-webhost-websockets-prism-unity"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

<h5 dir="auto"></h5>
<p dir="auto">A platform for trading crypto currencies and running crypto currency strategies. Built with <a href="#tradeview-wpf-ui">TradeView</a>, which is a WPF UI using the <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/origin">Origin</a> framework, and <a href="#tradeserver-aspnetcore-webhost">TradeServer</a>, a ASP.NET Core web host.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>TradeView</strong> and <strong>TradeServer</strong> enables you to:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Connect to your exchage accounts, trade currencies, manage open orders and your asset balances</li>
<li>Subscribe to live trade feed and order book for assets</li>
<li>Create and run your own custom trading strategies</li>
<li>Monitor running trading strategies</li>
<li>Send real-time updates to strategy parameters for running strategies</li>
<li>Easily extend the number of supported exchanges by creating wrappers for exchange api's that implement a common interface (<em>currently supports Binance and Kucoin exchanges</em>)</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Setting up your dev environment</h2><a id="user-content-setting-up-your-dev-environment" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Setting up your dev environment" href="#setting-up-your-dev-environment"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Download the source code. Open the solution file <strong>TradeView.sln</strong>, go to multiple start-up projects and select the following projects to start:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>DevelopmentInProgress.TradeView.Wpf.Host</li>
<li>DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.Console</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Compile and run the solution. This will start both the TradeView UI and the TradeServer WebHost, which runs as a console app.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Start Trading</h2><a id="user-content-start-trading" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Start Trading" href="#start-trading"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Select the <a href="#trading-module">Trading</a> module in the navigational panel then click <strong>Demo Account</strong>. This will open the trading tab for the <strong>Demo Account</strong> and connect to its exchange, Binance, and subscribe to order book and trade feed for the default asset.</p>
<p dir="auto">To trade you must create a new account. You can do this in the <a href="#configuration-module">Configuration</a> module by selecting <a href="#manage-accounts">Manage Accounts</a>. Specify the exchange and provide an api key and api secret (and optionally a api pass phrase e.g. for Kucoin accounts). Also sepcify the default asset. Once the account has been created you can access it in the <a href="#trading-module">Trading</a> module. You will see the account balances and real-time trade feed and order book for the default asset. You can start trading and receive real-time updates for your open orders.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Run a Strategy</h2><a id="user-content-run-a-strategy" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Run a Strategy" href="#run-a-strategy"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Select the <a href="#strategies-module">Strategies</a> module in the navigation panel and click the <strong>Binance Moving Average - ETHBTC</strong> demo strategy. This will open the strategy tab. From the drop down list in the top left corned select the server you want to run the strategy on. The default is <em>Trade Server</em>, which runs as a console app. Click on the <strong>Run Strategy</strong> button. This will upload the strategy to the <em>Trade Server</em> instance and start running it. In the <strong>Trade Server</strong> console window you will see logged in the console the request has been received to run the strategy. A webSocket connection is established between the <strong>TradeView</strong> and <strong>TradeServer</strong> and the <strong>TradeServer</strong> publishes notifications to the <strong>TradeView</strong> so the strategy can be monitored in real time.</p>
<p dir="auto"><em>Note: the demo strategy only shows the real time trades with moving average and buy / sell indicators above and below the moving average.</em></p>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><strong><em>TIP:</em></strong></p>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">See <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/issues/88" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/grantcolley/tradeview/issues/88/hovercard" aria-keyshortcuts="Alt+ArrowUp">thread #88</a> for some additional advice about getting the demo strategy to run.</p>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">See <a href="#strategies">Strategies</a> for more details of how running a strategy works.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Update a Running Strategy</h2><a id="user-content-update-a-running-strategy" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Update a Running Strategy" href="#update-a-running-strategy"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Strategy parameters contain information the startegy uses to determine when to buy and sell assets. You can update the parameters of a running strategy in real-time. For example, in the UI the strategy parameters is displayed in JSON format and can be edited. Bump the sell indicator of the demo strategy from <strong>0.00015</strong> to <strong>0.00115</strong> and then click the <strong>push</strong> button. The updated strategy parameters is pushed to the strategy running on the server. You will notice in the trade chart the sell indicator line is adjusted accordingly.</p>
<p dir="auto">See <a href="#updating-strategy-parameters">Updating Strategy Parameters</a> for more details of how updating strategy parameters works.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Create a Strategy</h2><a id="user-content-create-a-strategy" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Create a Strategy" href="#create-a-strategy"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Creating a strategy involves creating a class library with a class that inherits <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeView.Core/TradeStrategy/TradeStrategyBase.cs">TradeStrategyBase</a> which implements <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeView.Core/TradeStrategy/ITradeStrategy.cs">ITradeStrategy</a>.</p>
<p dir="auto">You will also need to create a config entry for the strategy in the <a href="#configuration-module">Configuration</a> module by selecting <a href="#manage-strategies">Manage Strategies</a>.</p>
<p dir="auto">The best way to understand how to create a strategy is to look at the demo strategy <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.Strategy.MovingAverage/MovingAverageStrategy.cs">MovingAverageStrategy</a> and how it has been configured.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Create a WPF Strategy Component</h2><a id="user-content-create-a-wpf-strategy-component" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Create a WPF Strategy Component" href="#create-a-wpf-strategy-component"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Creating a WPF strategy component involves creating a class library with a view model that inherits <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeView.Wpf.Common/ViewModel/StrategyDisplayViewModelBase.cs">StrategyDisplayViewModelBase</a> and a corresponding view.</p>
<p dir="auto">The best way to understand how to create a WPF strategy component is to look at the project <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/tree/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.Strategy.MovingAverage.Wpf">DevelopmentInProgress.Strategy.MovingAverage.Wpf</a> for an example of how the demo WPF strategy component has been created.</p>
<p dir="auto">You will also need to update the config entry for the strategy in the <a href="#configuration-module">Configuration</a> module by selecting <a href="#manage-strategies">Manage Strategies</a>.</p>

<p dir="auto">The Trading module shows a list of trading accounts in the navigation panel. Selecting an account will open a trading document in the main window for that account. From the trading document you can:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>see the account's balances</li>
<li>view realtime pricing of favourite symbols</li>
<li>select a symbol to subscribe to live orderbook and trade feed</li>
<li>place buy and sell orders</li>
<li>monitor and manage open orders in realtime</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">The Console</h2><a id="user-content-the-console" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: The Console" href="#the-console"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.Console/Program.cs">console app</a> takes three parameters:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>s</strong> = server name</li>
<li><strong>u</strong> = url of the webhost</li>
<li><strong>p</strong> = MaxDegreeOfParallelism for the dataflow StrategyRunnerActionBlock execution options</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">It creates and runs an instance of a WebHost, passing the parameters into it.</p>
<p dir="auto"><code>dotnet DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.Console.dll --s=ServerName --u=http://+:5500 --p=5</code></p>

<p dir="auto">The application uses <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/tree/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.Socket">Socket</a>, based on <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/dipsocket">DipSocket</a>, a lightweight publisher / subscriber implementation using WebSockets, for sending and receiving notifications to and from clients and servers. The <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.StrategyExecution.WebHost/Notification/Strategy/StrategyNotificationHub.cs">StrategyNotificationHub</a> inherits the abstract class <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.Socket/Server/SocketServer.cs">SocketServer</a> to manage client connections and channels. A client e.g. a running instance of <a href="#tradeview-wpf-ui">TradeView</a>, establishes a connection to the server with the purpose of running or monitoring a strategy on it. The strategy registers a Socket channel to which multiple client connections can subscribe. The strategy broadcasts notifications (e.g. live trade feed, buy and sell orders etc.) to the client connections. The <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.StrategyExecution.WebHost/Notification/Strategy/StrategyNotificationHub.cs">StrategyNotificationHub</a> overrides the OnClientConnectAsync and ReceiveAsync methods.</p>

                var connection = await base.AddWebSocketAsync(websocket).ConfigureAwait(false);

            <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
                <span class="pl-k">var</span> <span class="pl-s1">fileInfo</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-smi">FileInfo</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">file</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<p dir="auto">The <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.StrategyExecution.WebHost/Web/Middleware/RunStrategyMiddleware.cs">RunStrategyMiddleware</a> processes the request on the server. It deserialises the strategy and downloads the strategy assemblies into a sub directory under the working directory of the application. The running of the strategy is then passed to the <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.StrategyExecution.WebHost/Web/HostedService/StrategyRunnerActionBlock.cs">StrategyRunnerActionBlock</a>.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-cs notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre>                <span class="pl-k">var</span> <span class="pl-s1">json</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">context</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-s1">Request</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-s1">Form</span><span class="pl-kos">[</span><span class="pl-s">"strategy"</span><span class="pl-kos">]</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<div class="highlight highlight-source-cs notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre>          <span class="pl-s1">strategyRunnerActionBlock</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-s1">ActionBlock</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-smi">ActionBlock</span><span class="pl-c1"><</span><span class="pl-smi">StrategyRunnerActionBlockInput</span><span class="pl-c1">></span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-k">async</span> actionBlockInput <span class="pl-c1">=></span>

          <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-smi">ExecutionDataflowBlockOptions</span> <span class="pl-kos">{</span> <span class="pl-s1">MaxDegreeOfParallelism</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">server</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-s1">MaxDegreeOfParallelism</span> <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">The StrategyRunner</h4><a id="user-content-the-strategyrunner" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: The StrategyRunner" href="#the-strategyrunner"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">A strategy must implement <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeView.Core/TradeStrategy/ITradeStrategy.cs">ITradeStrategy</a>.
The <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.StrategyExecution.WebHost/StrategyRunner.cs">StrategyRunner</a> will load the strategy's assembly and all its dependencies into memory and create an instance of the strategy. It will subscribe to strategy events to handle notifications from the strategy to the client connection i.e. the <a href="#tradeview-wpf-ui">TradeView</a> UI. The strategy is added to <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.StrategyExecution.WebHost/Cache/TradeStrategy/TradeStrategyCacheManager.cs">TradeStrategyCacheManager</a> and the <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.StrategyExecution.WebHost/Cache/Subscriptions/SubscriptionsCacheManager.cs">SubscriptionsCacheManager</a> subscribes to the strategy's feeds i.e. trade, orderbook, account updates etc. Finally, the <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeView.Core/TradeStrategy/ITradeStrategy.cs">ITradeStrategy.RunAsync</a> method is called to run the strategy.</p>

        <span class="pl-kos">{</span>

            <span class="pl-k">try</span>
            <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
                <span class="pl-k">var</span> <span class="pl-s1">dependencies</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">GetAssemblies</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">localPath</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

                <span class="pl-kos">{</span>
                    <span class="pl-k">await</span> <span class="pl-s1">subscriptionsCacheManager</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">Subscribe</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">strategy</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">tradeStrategy</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">ConfigureAwait</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-c1">false</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

                    <span class="pl-s1">tradeStrategy</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-s1">StrategyTradeEvent</span> <span class="pl-c1">-=</span> <span class="pl-s1">StrategyTradeEvent</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>
                    <span class="pl-s1">tradeStrategy</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-s1">StrategyCustomNotificationEvent</span> <span class="pl-c1">-=</span> <span class="pl-s1">StrategyCustomNotificationEvent</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="        internal async Task<Strategy> RunStrategyAsync(Strategy strategy, string localPath)
        {
            ITradeStrategy tradeStrategy = null;

            try
            {
                var dependencies = GetAssemblies(localPath);

                var assemblyLoader = new AssemblyLoader(localPath, dependencies);
                var assembly = assemblyLoader.LoadFromMemoryStream(Path.Combine(localPath, strategy.TargetAssembly));
                var type = assembly.GetType(strategy.TargetType);
                dynamic obj = Activator.CreateInstance(type);

                tradeStrategy = (ITradeStrategy)obj;

                tradeStrategy.StrategyNotificationEvent += StrategyNotificationEvent;
                tradeStrategy.StrategyAccountInfoEvent += StrategyAccountInfoEvent;
                tradeStrategy.StrategyOrderBookEvent += StrategyOrderBookEvent;
                tradeStrategy.StrategyTradeEvent += StrategyTradeEvent;
                tradeStrategy.StrategyStatisticsEvent += StrategyStatisticsEvent;
                tradeStrategy.StrategyCandlesticksEvent += StrategyCandlesticksEvent;
                tradeStrategy.StrategyCustomNotificationEvent += StrategyCustomNotificationEvent;

                strategy.Status = StrategyStatus.Running;

                if(tradeStrategyCacheManager.TryAddTradeStrategy(strategy.Name, tradeStrategy))
                {
                    await subscriptionsCacheManager.Subscribe(strategy, tradeStrategy).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    
                    var result = await tradeStrategy.RunAsync(strategy, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);

                    if(!tradeStrategyCacheManager.TryRemoveTradeStrategy(strategy.Name, out ITradeStrategy ts))
                    {
                        Notify(NotificationLevel.Error, $"Failed to remove {strategy.Name} from the cache manager.");
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Notify(NotificationLevel.Error, $"Failed to add {strategy.Name} to the cache manager.");
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                if(tradeStrategy != null)
                {
                    subscriptionsCacheManager.Unsubscribe(strategy, tradeStrategy);

                    tradeStrategy.StrategyNotificationEvent -= StrategyNotificationEvent;
                    tradeStrategy.StrategyAccountInfoEvent -= StrategyAccountInfoEvent;
                    tradeStrategy.StrategyOrderBookEvent -= StrategyOrderBookEvent;
                    tradeStrategy.StrategyTradeEvent -= StrategyTradeEvent;
                    tradeStrategy.StrategyCustomNotificationEvent -= StrategyCustomNotificationEvent;
                }
            }

            return strategy;
        }" tabindex="0" role="button">

<p dir="auto">The <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.StrategyExecution.WebHost/Cache/TradeStrategy/TradeStrategyCacheManager.cs">TradeStrategyCacheManager</a> caches running instances of strategies and is used to <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.StrategyExecution.WebHost/Web/Middleware/IsStrategyRunningMiddleware.cs">check if a strategy is running</a>, <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.StrategyExecution.WebHost/Web/Middleware/UpdateStrategyMiddleware.cs">update a running strategy's parameters</a>, and <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeServer.StrategyExecution.WebHost/Web/Middleware/StopStrategyMiddleware.cs">stopping a strategy</a>.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Monitoring a Running Strategy</h2><a id="user-content-monitoring-a-running-strategy" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Monitoring a Running Strategy" href="#monitoring-a-running-strategy"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The application uses <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/tree/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.Socket">Socket</a>, based on <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/dipsocket">DipSocket</a>, a lightweight publisher / subscriber implementation using WebSockets, for sending and receiving notifications to and from clients and servers.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">The Client Request to Monitor a Strategy</h4><a id="user-content-the-client-request-to-monitor-a-strategy" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: The Client Request to Monitor a Strategy" href="#the-client-request-to-monitor-a-strategy"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

<p dir="auto"><strong>TradeView</strong> is intended to trade against multiple exchanges and the following api's are currently supported:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><a href="https://github.com/sonvister/Binance">Binance</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/JKorf/Kucoin.Net">Kucoin.Net</a></li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">To add a new api create a new .NET Standard project for the API wrapper and create a class that implements <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeView.Core/Interfaces/IExchangeApi.cs">IExchangeApi</a>.
For example see <a href="https://github.com/grantcolley/tradeview/blob/master/src/DevelopmentInProgress.TradeView.Api.Binance/BinanceExchangeApi.cs">BinanceExchangeApi</a>.</p>

<span class="pl-kos">{</span>

            <span class="pl-k">using</span> <span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-k">var</span> <span class="pl-s1">apiUser</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-k">new</span> <span class="pl-smi">BinanceApiUser</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">user</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-s1">ApiKey</span><span class="pl-kos">,</span> <span class="pl-s1">user</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-s1">ApiSecret</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span>
            <span class="pl-kos">{</span>

    public class BinanceExchangeApi : IExchangeApi
    {
        public async Task<Order> PlaceOrder(User user, ClientOrder clientOrder)
        {
            var binanceApi = new BinanceApi();
            using (var apiUser = new BinanceApiUser(user.ApiKey, user.ApiSecret))
            {
                var order = OrderHelper.GetOrder(apiUser, clientOrder);
                var result = await binanceApi.PlaceAsync(order).ConfigureAwait(false);

            }
        }

        public async Task<string> CancelOrderAsync(User user, string symbol, string orderId, string newClientOrderId = null, long recWindow = 0, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
        {
            var binanceApi = new BinanceApi();
            var id = Convert.ToInt64(orderId);
            using (var apiUser = new BinanceApiUser(user.ApiKey, user.ApiSecret))
            {
                var result = await binanceApi.CancelOrderAsync(apiUser, symbol, id, newClientOrderId, recWindow, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                return result;
            }
        }" tabindex="0" role="button">
